title: kuhnistera emarginata
intro: Kuhnistera emarginata, commonly known as the "Lipstick Flower" or "Painted Lip Flower", is a flowering plant species in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
